'''Joanna Bauldreay''' is a British chemist and Aviation Fuel Development Manager at [[Shell Global Solutions]].

== Early life and education ==
Bauldreay studied [[Natural Sciences (Cambridge)|Natural Sciences]] at [[Newnham College, Cambridge]], matriculating in 1976.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news|url=https://www.alumni.cam.ac.uk/get-involved/networks-and-volunteers-working-group|title=Networks and Volunteers Working Group|work=Alumni|access-date=2018-05-31|language=en}}</ref> She was awarded a [[Half Blue]] for cricket, and continues to play sports.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.tattenhall.org/news/splendid-bowling-competition.html|title=Splendid Bowling Competition|website=Tattenhall Online|language=en|access-date=2018-05-31}}</ref> Bauldreay joined the [[University of Southampton]] for her graduate studies, earning a master's degree in [[Electrochemistry|Electrochemical]] Science.<ref name=":0" /> She completed her PhD at [[Newnham College, Cambridge]], under the supervision of [[Mary Archer]].<ref>{{Cite journal|date=1983-11-01|title=Dye-modified electrodes for photogalvanic cells|journal=Electrochimica Acta|language=en|volume=28|issue=11|pages=1515–1522|doi=10.1016/0013-4686(83)85210-4|issn=0013-4686|last1=Bauldreay|first1=J.M.|last2=Archer|first2=M.D.}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|date=1985-10-01|title=Mediated redox reactions at the 1-aminophenazine-modified rotating disc electrode|journal=Electrochimica Acta|language=en|volume=30|issue=10|pages=1355–1359|doi=10.1016/0013-4686(85)85014-3|issn=0013-4686|last1=Bauldreay|first1=J.M.|last2=Archer|first2=M.D.}}</ref>

== Research and career ==
In 1986, after a postdoctoral position at [[Rice University]] in [[Houston, Texas]], Bauldreay joined the [[Royal Dutch Shell|Royal Dutch Shell Group.]]<ref name=":0" /> She is Fuel Development Manager at [[Shell Global Solutions]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.solar-jet.aero/page/partners/shell-5.php|title=SOLAR-JET - Partners|website=www.solar-jet.aero|language=en|access-date=2018-05-31|archive-date=20 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180620002101/http://www.solar-jet.aero/page/partners/shell-5.php|url-status=dead}}</ref> She is considered an expert in aviation fuel.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aerospaceonline.com/doc/aiaa-to-host-inside-aerospace-an-0001|title=AIAA To Host "Inside Aerospace" - An International Forum For Aerospace Leaders On Energy And Environmental Challenges|website=www.aerospaceonline.com|language=en|access-date=2018-05-31}}</ref> She has a number of patents, covering liquid kerosene.<ref>{{Citation|title=Liquid fuel compositions|date=2010-04-28|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/US20100218417A1/en|accessdate=2018-05-31}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|title=Kerosene base fuel|date=2009-03-17|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2009117426A1/de|accessdate=2018-05-31}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|title=Methods of providing higher quality liquid kerosene based-propulsion fuels|date=2016-12-21|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2017112718A1/en|accessdate=2018-05-31}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|title=Process for the preparation of middle distillates from kerogen|date=2008-03-17|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2009116988A1/en|accessdate=2018-05-31}}</ref> She explores a range of emerging technologies, including synthetic kerosine containing aromatics, alcohol-to-jet, hydrotreated depolymerised cellulosic jet and aqueous phase reforming.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.airtn.eu/wp-content/uploads/airtn-frankfurt-bauldreay.pdf|title=Alternative Fuels - Alternatives and Production|last=Bauldreay|first=Joanna|date=2012-10-08|website=Air Transport Net|access-date=2018-05-31}}</ref>

She was awarded a 2017 International Association for Stability, Handling and Use of Liquid Fuels (IASH) Lifetime Achievement award for her technical advancements in petroleum- and synthetic based jet fuel.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.iash.net/the-iash-lifetime-achievement-award|title=The IASH Lifetime Achievement Award|last=Admin|first=MemberClicks|website=www.iash.net|language=en-us|access-date=2018-05-31}}</ref>
